_note: Items enemies drop when they fall (each enemy's "drop" in units.json says which). A hero who ends a walk on that tile picks it up into the party's bag. Using one takes the hero's action, on itself or on an ally up to "range" tiles away. heal = health back, mp = magic back (only units with MP), cure = "poison" cures poison. Up to 4 different items fit in the menu.

ether.name: Ether
ether.text: Gives back 6 MP (only casters have MP).
